candidate_diff_sha256: SHA256 of the actual archived reviewed6-native-file patch bytes, verified against source authority candidate_diff artifact
source_manifest_sha256: externally reviewed SHA256 supplied independently on command line; not trusted from these receipts
source_root: absolute complete archive-plus-reviewed-overlay snapshot under build_root

source_file_sha256.relative/source/path: SHA256; EXACT complete map equality with caller-pinned source authority

flags.GATO_EXPERIMENT_TELEMETRY: boolean false for OFF, true for ON

module.path: absolute build-owned bsqpN32_tiago_right*.so; only exact receipt-bound module output may appear as an extra file inside snapshot

direct_cmake_cache.path: absolute directtarget CMakeCache.txt; typed exact telemetry/Release/architecture; N32/plant hardcoded in independently reviewed direct source

compiler_resource_log.path: absolute nonempty build-owned compiler commands/resource log; root reviews command and ptxas resource scope

compiled_dependencies.path: absolute build-owned JSON inventory from actual compiler depfiles; schema below

local_source_files: all compiled local relative dependency paths; every byte also covered by complete source authority

external_dependency_sha256.absolute/selected/SDK/header/path: SHA256, validated before import; all caller-authority entries must be retained

depfile_sha256.absolute/build-owned/compiler-depfile/pa: SHA256; actual compiler generated files retained, root audits inventory completeness

candidate_diff.sha256: SHA256 verified against real artifact bytes

source_file_sha256.canonical/relative/path: SHA256 for EVERY archived/overlaid file, including all local solver/dynamics/generated headers and Python wrapper/package files; no manifest self-entry

caller_pinned_source_authority_schema.build_flags: exact common flags object above, excluding only GATO_EXPERIMENT_TELEMETRY

external_dependency_sha256.absolute/selected/SDK/header/path: optional additional root-pinned SDK hashes; absence does not claim full system-header certificate

caller_pinned_source_authority_schema.review_attestations: Root may additionally retain source archive/overlay receipts and independent scope review hashes in this pinned object.

trust_boundary: Caller independently reviews complete source authority and pins its SHA256. The driver verifies this authority, patch bytes, receipt equality, complete source inventory, all file bytes and recorded dependency bytes before imports. Self-hashed receipts cannot replace source authority. Module/compiler build provenance still requires root review of actual commands/logs/depfiles and receipt artifact hashes; this is not a digital signature.
